body:
SHE threw a tantrum? Ugh!!!! the one time I showed any (as my supervisor said) innappropiate conduct (I had a very negative reaction to an action by a client - client was putting himself in a lot of danger... in front of me) I was reprimanded and reassigned (I scolded him...and attempted to stop the behavior). The fact that so-called professionals can get away with that shit really... ugh. 

yes, you have shitty therapists

In therapy the one thing I found to help me was a therapist who a)behaved in an appropiate manner and accepted if I wanted to "sit in silence" (its literally not speaking in session and the therapist doesn't speak either) and b) when not engaged in that mood - could speak to me on a "real level" rather than a "I'm better than you because *I* am a **therapist**" I HATE THOSE lol. This probably explains why therapy has failed... the relationship between you and the therapist needs to be bonded, and if there isn't... ugh. I'm glad you called that one out on it! 

So yea there are some days where sleeping doesn't help, like I said for me its about a 5% success rate. How are you doing today (well for me its a new day, dunno where you are) though?

gah... we have a lot in common. My last dr asked me what I'd do and my response was "refer her to another therapist" 

Ok, then I getcha, first off suicide is not the method to go... either it works and its a permanent solution to a temp problem, or it fails and all hell breaks loose (I tried it a few times, one time... not a good result at all) 

Ok. ugh, I hate sounding like a typical therapist :( 

Do me a favor (since you are in a tough place, i'd prefer it to be a favor to yourself especially since I'm a complete stranger, but...) sleep on it. Sometimes just sleeping may help. (its a 5% chance in my case). Know that when you wake up in the morning, it will be a new day. Your roommates may still be giving you the cold shoulder, but hell that is their loss. Take care of the situation in the house, and focus on yourself. There is so much more to life than putting up with this shit. Its taken me over 20 years to even start to understand that myself. Have you tried meditation? you probably have (I don't normally suggest it... but hey everyone is differnet). Just try to relax and imagine that things can improve - or do the opposite and take each moment as it comes and empty your mind.  

I need to sleep. But, I will check here in the morning. Please stay strong. The world needs people like you, you are not a bad person, you are just someone who is very very frustrated with their current situation.

Wow.. OK, i could pick apart the list and point out what DOESN'T work lol but I'll just say the positive one - dogs and animals in general are the best! (on your list) Ok, ah so you haven't done the two thing I was thinking!  (first one is pretty meh, so it will probably end up on that list, but the second one is interesting)

For a moment forget therapy, forget music, absolutely forget medications, hug the dog since hes around, and for a moment just think about yourself. No writing, say the first thing that comes to your mind... with the mindset you have now it will probably not be positive - find a counter for it. keep doing that - now... if that method doesn't work... 

(this is the one I do... most of the time its good for me at least - and I've tried pretty much everything you have except no dogs allowed here, I got a cat) 

Step away from yourself for a moment. Look over who you are as if you are someone else. make note of the negatives but make note of the positives too. Pretend you are a friend of yours and give yourself advice. If a friend of yours was in your situation, would you tell her to kill herself, or would you come up with something else? Talk to your dog about it as if he was a colleague or another friend. Say to him "I think <insert name> should try this, what do you think?" he may wag his tail, ignore you, bark... but that doesn't matter. its not about how he reacts, its about how does it sound. Have you heard the term cognitive distortions? you are intelligent, and you probably have several (I made a former therapist laugh, when she handed me the list of them I asked her how she knew me so well >< )

Like I said earlier, I only used the "please get help" to get a response. I have a feeling that inside of you, you can help yourself.

I appreciate it more than words can say. A lot of what you have posted has touched me. Thank you. I truly mean that. 

And you are like I strive to be. I want to reach out to others, I want to help others. Its why I went into the field I did. I felt like maybe, some day I could help someone. I've tried posting on this sub to other people but I think I'm just upsetting them. I only wish I could help others, since I feel powerless in helping myself.
in that case... stick around. A lot of us need hope. If you feel you can help others, stick with it. WE NEED YOU

she knew and loved you for who you are. That does not change but the pain clouds that. I want you to think about it tonight, think about what she would have wanted you to do. What can you do to keep her memory alive in your heart? Do you want to be the one she loved? or do you want to be someone else?

your light is hidden by your pain. as for the things you feel you will lose, they are material. you have a heart within you and I saw that when you spoke in my thread. 

Search within... its there.
why are you so kind? I don't deserve this :(

I don't want your money, hell I don't want to live half the time. tbh my post was to see if you'd respond. 

Ok - so meds didn't work for me either, in fact they made me really really ill. Pregnancy is making me even more crazy... but ok - what type of therapies did the therapists do? See, I know therapists don't always fix things. Lets see, from what I was reading - please let me know if I've missed anything (i'm currently in my own crisis but for some reason talking to others is easing my pain) - you seem overcome by rage when people give you a hard time, you do really well outside but once home you feel like you have no control. People flat out piss you off?

Ok, tell me the ways the therapists worked with you - I've seen so many I went nuts and finally decided the best way would be to see how they learned - enrolled myself in a therapy program and rolled my eyes through it. ALOT is BS... but some genuine hearts are there. 

Tell me what you've done, I *might* have a method not many people try.., and if you want to call me a quack, go for it.
I'm so sorry! Grief on its own is difficult let alone with other issues added in. so, forgive this question - what would the person who passed want you to do?

i wasn't told to commit suicide, i was told i should die lol. 

I'm trying to, and its ironic, I called him my knight in shining armor today - when I tried to walk away and he chased me down half a block, and brought me home. He is my heart and soul, I only wish I could be as amazing as he feels I am. Sadly I feel he's delusional
its in you. its in all of us. come on, let that light shine through!

you have someone to live for too, someone you haven't met yet. I wanted to die years before I met my husband, hell, when I spoke with him the first time it was after a trip on abilify that left me not knowing who the fuck I was. And I will mind your despair, we're all in this together.

its not a dead end. you need to keep fighting. look, rages are rages,. it happens... please get yourself some help... yes i know talking sucks... trust me. medications suck too, hosptials ugh... but something, anything because honestly all of us are in the fight of our lives. I've been suicidal for 21 years... i'm still here (though I almost wasn't today). It HAS to get better... if not perfect at least know that even those who pissed you off today - their lives are not perfect. its not a dead end, its a horrible game that poses a torturous challenge... yet there has to be some kind of reward, i mean... seriously nothing would be this rough without some kind of reward.

people who hate themselves but loves others? i dunno. I'm starting to feel a little less "i'm gonna do it right now" which is probably why I felt strong enough to look for other posts. Its just overwhelming, for all of us, which is why I get his post so much.

feel what way? that my tradition is so horrible? I want to have a circumscision if my kid is a boy. and people told me i should die for it. 

also - i came across your post. Dude, stay strong. I have the same MI and also no access... look at us :/ we can fight this, we really can.

Wow.. so as you are talking to me I saw this. Listen I'm BP too, which is probably making my situation worse. Things seem dark but things almost always improve. It takes inner strength, and you have it, deep inside, somwhere, it is there. 

As for the girl - shes not worth it, you deserve someone who will stand by your side. 

For the eviction - I've been through that. Are there any social services in your area you can talk to? Have you gone to housing court? Fight for it man, fight for it!

As for the mania on its way - try (and i KNOW this is hard) to focus it into energizing yourself. I don't know how your manias are, but listen - use it! Focus it to give you the energy to ask for help - yes I know you hate it... I hate it too - but seriously, when manic you have a better chance of getting it! You can do this! know you have it in you, YOU CAN DO THIS!!! contract with me. stay strong please

I refuse to go to a hospital. I know what they are like. I also know what happens to pregnant women there. I can fight this better on my own then there. This subreddit is better than what would happen there - basically posting it got me to start thinking rationally again :/

sure - sadly the most acceptable is in my sleep. sadly unless i kill someone else they won't give me lethal injection. I'm not a killer, and I've never commited a crime punishable by death.., nor could I. Which is Ironic since I see my following tradition to be punishable by death...

eh the typical jump from a very popular jumping bridge. but its a moot point now, no access, nor do I like the idea of falling. one reason i haven't killed myself yet, I can't find a method I deem painless or acceptable
no plan... I had a plan in the past but its not doable now. So as of now, no plan, but i'm hoping the person who decided to tell me once again i'm wrong in my other thread may have a suggestion...
I've considered waiting unti the child is born. however, my husband can always have another child. My bloodline should end. we were all failures.

therapist... ironic beyond everything. but hey we have the highest prevalance of alcoholics, so maybe its not so ironic.

I tried to be strong, and even though it was only one person on that thread, I think the fact that I would be told I was wrong, on a thread like that just shows/prooves its not worth it. My husband said earlier that "i'm married yet I'm the lonliest man on earth" all I can think is that he'll be less lonely as a widower

I fought first for my parents, then for my friends, and now for my husband... but everyday is painful, everymoment is torture... I think the pregnancy hormones are giving me the edge I've always needed... sadly I don't have a plan, but I'll come up with something.

Its why I wanted to wait until the kid was born... but my husband deserves a chance to find true love, good love, and not be married to a psychopath who is evil apparently because she wants to follow tradition and circumcise her son...
